verdict.rationale: Pricing model is a fair question for an AI customer-support platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions pricing, per-resolution billing, published rates, or spend caps. The 'control' mentions refer to guardrails and experiments, not billing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote
